g.text: Defense-in-Depth Concurrency Control • Atomic Redis Lua Multi-Seat Holds • Reactive SSE Streaming • PostgreSQL Partial Unique Constraints
• TanStack React Query v5 (Optimistic UI & Invalidation)
• React Router v6 (Public Catalogue & Protected Booking)
Seat state: DB + Redis hold merge
• SQL: SELECT * FROM bookings FOR UPDATE
TIER 1 CONCURRENCY DEFENSE: Sub-millisecond mutual exclusion before hitting database
All-or-nothing: returns 0 if any held, else sets all.
TIER 2 CONCURRENCY DEFENSE: Relational engine barriers guarantee zero duplicate bookings
PHYSICAL BARRIER: Zero double confirmed seats
Prevents duplicate booking creation on client retry.
